article-meta.related-article: This corrects the article "Targeting CLDN18.2 by CD3 Bispecific and ADC Modalities for the Treatments of Gastric and Pancreatic Cancer", 8420.

body.p: Correction to: Scientific Reports 10.1038/s41598-019-44874-0, published online 10 June 2019
This Article contains a typographical error in the Materials and Methods section under subheading ‘Immunohistochemistry and scoring’ where,

“Formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tumor sections or tumor microarrays were processed and stained with anti-CLDN18.2 mAb, followed by detection with EnVision HRP-labeled polymer anti-rabbit second Ab (Dako K4002) based on standard protocol.”

“Formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tumor sections or tumor microarrays were processed and stained with anti-CLDN18.2 mAb, followed by detection with EnVision HRP-labeled polymer anti-mouse second Ab (Dako K4001) based on standard protocol.”
